description: Use this when the connected user wants AIApply to apply for them, and again whenever they come back to it: it says what is still missing — their resume, their confirmed job preferences, or applying being active on the account — and next_step names the one thing to do now. Follow message. setup.suggested holds the values read from their resume, for the user to confirm. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one.
name: get_setup_status

applying_active.description: Whether applying is active on this account.

can_search.description: Whether AIApply searches for and queues jobs for this user.

search_only.description: A period in which AIApply searches for jobs for this account without applying to them, if one was set up.

suggested.description: Values read from the resume. Show every one; ask about each field in ask_the_user.

title: Get AIApply setup status
